QuestInfo.name: Start the Counterattack
QuestInfo.0: The plan worked! Everyone in Pantheon is celebrating your victory. But there is still work to be done. The weak Specters are down, but the stronger ones are still kicking. Talk to #p3000000# about clearing the remaining Specters.
QuestInfo.1: #bDefeat all the Specters#k inside the Protective Shield.\n#rIf you fail the quest, you can forfeit it and start again.#k
QuestInfo.2: Despite your success against the invaders, Magnus himself appeared to take you, #p3000007#, and the Angelic Buster down a notch. Even in his weakened state, he mopped the floor with you.

1.0: Magnus...is unbelievable. I didn't expect him to hit Pantheon directly. And even under the Protective Shield, he was a terror. And his sword...that has to be the Kaiserium. The great sword of Kaiser has been corrupted. This is unacceptable.
1.1: If Magnus is this strong...I don't know if we can retake Heliseum. Man, what a bummer.

yes.0: Well, we still beat the stuffing out of Magnus's army. We can be proud of that.

default.0:
Defeat all the remaining Elite Specters at the southern boundary.

#b(If you've returned without clearing the Battleground Map, you need to forfeit the quest and start it again.)#k
